name: sms
description: EduManage — School Management System (React+TS+shadcn / Express+TS / Prisma / PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run prisma:push && npm --prefix server run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
